name: onboarding-update
//: An update (notes seen at an older version, installed before Changes came): What's new shows alone, and no feature tip opens beside it, however long it is open; its Got it leads to the tips of what it announced (Changes, 'New'); then nothing more this visit. The download menu's Print and Ctrl+P in the ⚡ view print the ⚡ Instant PDF (a frame of it, printed).

steps.what: nothing beside What's new while it is open

steps.check: (() => { const t = document.getElementById('phitex-news'); const pane = document.querySelector('.pdf'); if (!t || !pane) return 'none'; const p = pane.getBoundingClientRect(), r = t.getBoundingClientRect(); const cx = p.left + p.width / 2, cy = p.top + p.height / 2; return { inPane: r.left >= p.left - 1 && r.right <= p.right + 1 }; return { step: t.querySelector('.phitex-callout-step')?.textContent ?? '', inPane: r.left >= p.left - 1 && r.right <= p.right + 1, centre: r.left < cx && r.right > cx && r.top < cy && r.bottom > cy }; })()
steps.what: What's new inside the PDF pane
then, the tip of what it announced: Changes, New

steps.check: (() => { document.getElementById('phitex-dlmore').click(); const b = document.querySelector('#phitex-dlmenu [data-dl=print]'); const shown = !!b && document.getElementById('phitex-dlmenu').classList.contains('show'); b?.click(); return shown; })()

steps.what: Print: the ⚡ Instant PDF in a frame, printed

steps.check: (() => { const P = document.querySelector('phitex-preview'); P.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', { bubbles: true, composed: true })); const e = new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'p', ctrlKey: true, bubbles: true, composed: true, cancelable: true }); P.dispatchEvent(e); return e.defaultPrevented; })()
steps.what: Ctrl+P in the ⚡ view is ours

steps.check: (() => { document.getElementById('phitex-print')?.remove(); const c = document.body.appendChild(document.createElement('textarea')); c.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', { bubbles: true })); c.focus(); const e = new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'p', ctrlKey: true, bubbles: true, cancelable: true }); c.dispatchEvent(e); c.remove(); return e.defaultPrevented || !!document.getElementById('phitex-print'); })()
steps.what: Ctrl+P outside the PDF pane (the editor's side): Overleaf's own
